responsibility: This header implements GCC's lightweight dynamic type-query and checked-cast framework for compiler data structures. Through is_a_helper specializations and helpers such as is_a, as_a, safe_as_a, dyn_cast, and safe_dyn_cast, it provides compile-time-extensible runtime discrimination among related node types like symtab, gimple, or tree subclasses, giving GCC a standardized alternative to ad hoc tag tests and unchecked casts.
